title: Private school: change of use of a house in a residential district — Yauco, zone X
description: We are converting a house we own in a residential neighborhood of Yauco into a small private elementary school for about 40 students. This is a change of use from residence to school; interior work only.

change_of_use.evidence: change of use from residence to school

occupancy_change.evidence: change of use from residence to school

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0699: confirmed change of use -> new Permiso Unico for the new use.
RULE_0710: change of use at a pin in a residential district (location.zoning.residential) -> consulta de ubicacion.
RULE_0192 / RULE_0039: staff background checks where children are present.

mustNotInclude.rationale: FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
Pin outside the official coastal zone: RULE_0708 needs location.czm.
No alcohol: RULE_0013/0014 need Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD / Q_ALCOHOL_SERVED; business-type alcohol rules exist only for Bar / Juice Bar.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.

ordering.rationale: RC-2023: the consulta de ubicacion (land-use siting) is decided before the Permiso Unico for the new use (no KB edge).
KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.

notes: Added 2026-10-13 by the scenario loop: first private-school scenario and first Yauco scenario. School accreditation (Consejo de Educación / Ley 212-2018 licensing) is not asserted here; it is not modeled as a KB document yet.
